# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 (as of v01:c15:p0011)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome girl with bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump, showy figure. She has long, thick, golden hair, which she likes to wear up in town. She is considered the handsomest girl of her year at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and inclined to be emotional or hysterical. She thinks constantly about boys, beaux, and romance, and enjoys the pleasant things in life frankly. While she finds studying and serious topics uninteresting, she is a member of the story club and enjoys social events.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## Traits

- Emotional and hysterical  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021)</sub>
- Fixated on beaux and young men  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing sentimental stories  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- To have a beau as soon as she is fifteen and get married after teaching for two years  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Ruby attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Gilbert Blythe. She participated in the school concert, lending Anne her slippers for the performance. Later, she joined Miss Stacy's Queen's preparation class and eventually attended Queen's Academy in Charlottetown to earn a teacher's license. After passing her examinations, she accepted a teaching position at a school up west.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P43](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0043), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
